edit.description: `layout_unit` (:557) parses the document into a `LayoutReading` and keeps only `fields`/`edges`; `local_document_rows` (:901) then re-parses the identical text through `drift::lower_layout_document` for `members`/`satisfies`/`prose`, recomputing the same `edge_fields` at :917 that `resolve_kind_units` already built at :761. Thread the one reading (or its lowered rows) out of `resolve_kind_units` to `assemble_lock_family` (:1116) instead — its three call sites (:851, :1116, :1825) all sit in this file.

`lower_layout_document` (:2111) splits so the `layout.read` parse and the row lowering are separable for a caller that already holds a reading; the new parse count joins the existing count family (`LAYOUT_DOCUMENT_READS` :57, and the `LOCK_READS`/`LOCK_PARSES` read-vs-parse pairing :44 that is this pin's precedent).
`Layout::read` (:221) is the one door every parse comes through — the increment sits here so the count is the pass's true parse total, whichever module owns the accessor.
The parse pin, beside `a_local_layout_members_document_is_read_once_per_assembly_pass` (:1252) on the same two-member `knob` fixture.

summary: A local-locus layout member's document is parsed twice per assembly pass — `layout_unit` keeps only the reading's fields, then `local_document_rows` re-parses the identical text.

per.section: Cost scale is hoisted, and pinned by count

tests.asserts: `assemble_lock_family` over a two-member `knob` harness parses two layout documents, not four, with the derived `nested` rows asserted present first so the count cannot pass over an empty derivation

acceptance: `cargo test` and `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` green, with the new parse-count pin verified red (4, not 2) on the pre-fix tree.
notes: Both parses take provably identical inputs — same kind, same text, `edge_fields` built by the same two calls (:761 vs :917) — so the fold is semantics-preserving. Do not widen `Unit` to carry the reading: derived state is computed, never stored beside its source (engineering.md). The disk-read half is already hoisted (7e28b11f); this is the parse half that commit's own body named as left standing. scoped at 380a926a
